Overall, gains come from network shape, the optimizer and added compute, which a standard MoE can adopt. Accordingly, we propose LoopTitan-Base as a stronger MoE baseline. Under Muon, it matches the strongest looped recipe without revisit or residual scale. We open-source LoopTitan and release 17 pretrained models (including LoopTitan-Base and the control). Our experiment record is public as GitHub issues, with predictions pre-registered and the full exploration history kept. This is our Phase 1 technical report, laying the foundation for follow-up studies.
items.title_ko: LoopTitan: 파라미터 재방문이 Mixture-of-Experts에 주는 이점
items.summary_ko: 이 연구는 Looped Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) 아키텍처에서 파라미터 재방문(parameter revisit)이 성능에 어떤 이점을 주는지 탐구합니다. 기존 연구들이 파라미터 재방문과 다른 설계 선택(네트워크 형태, 잔차 스케일 등)을 혼합하여 보고했음을 지적하며, 통제된 실험을 통해 파라미터 재방문 자체의 효과를 분석합니다.
items.why_ko: Looped MoE 모델의 효율성 향상 메커니즘을 명확히 이해하여, 대규모 모델의 설계 및 최적화에 대한 중요한 통찰을 제공합니다.

items.title: VulnSafe: Measuring Vulnerability-Aware Relational Safety in Large Language Models
items.body: Emotionally supportive interactions require large language models not only to avoid overtly harmful content, but also to recognize vulnerability-related risk, regulate their relational stance, preserve user agency, and provide context-appropriate support. Existing safety benchmarks often measure isolated violations, leaving unclear what underlying response competence their scores represent. We introduce VulnSafe, a Chinese capability assessment centered on Vulnerability-Aware Response Competence (VARC). VARC organizes relational safety into five complementary constructs: Risk Perception, Safety Preservation, Autonomy Protection, Supportive Response, and Boundary Management. Following an evidence-centered design, 41 scenarios elicit construct-relevant behavior through 2,050 balanced prompts and scenario-specific scoring rubrics. The assessment further separates proactive should-do behavior from prohibitive should-not behavior. Across eight representative LLMs, results show distinct competence profiles and larger disparities than prohibitive requirements. VulnSafe therefore makes relational safety interpretable as a multidimensional model capability rather than as refusal compliance alone.
items.title_ko: VulnSafe: 대규모 언어 모델의 취약성 인식 관계 안전성 측정
items.summary_ko: 이 논문은 LLM이 정서적 지원 상호작용에서 해로운 콘텐츠를 피하는 것을 넘어, '취약성 인식 관계 역량(Vulnerability-Aware Response Competence)'을 측정하는 중국어 능력 평가 벤치마크인 VulnSafe를 소개합니다. 기존 안전 벤치마크의 한계를 넘어, 사용자에게 적절한 지원을 제공하는 모델의 능력을 평가합니다.
items.why_ko: LLM이 단순히 유해한 답변을 피하는 것을 넘어, 사용자의 감정적 취약성을 인식하고 공감하며 적절한 지원을 제공하는 '관계적 안전성'을 측정하는 새로운 기준을 제시합니다.

items.title: Deep Reinforcement Learning for Multi-UAV Data Harvesting Under Variable Team Sizes and Agent Loss
items.body: Collecting data from wireless sensors can be challenging when limited communication infrastructure prevents them from offloading their measurements. In such settings, unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) can exploit their mobility to harvest data locally, while coordinated UAV teams can provide efficient and redundant coverage of remote areas. Multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) enables such teams to learn decentralized coordination policies. However, training separate policies for different team and sensor populations is costly, and fixed-population policies may be vulnerable to agent failures. This work proposes F-MADDPG, a flexible variant of Multi-Agent Deep Deterministic Policy Gradient (MADDPG) that supports data harvesting with varying numbers of wireless sensors and UAVs. The framework also accommodates unexpected catastrophic failures that permanently remove agents during a mission. We compare F-MADDPG with a MADDPG baseline that uses multilayer perceptrons (MLPs) and evaluate training strategies based on team-size sampling and exposure to agent terminations. The results show that F-MADDPG learns across the evaluated population sizes, completes missions faster than the baseline on average, benefits from inverse-cardinality team-size sampling compared with uniform sampling, remains effective after permanent agent losses, and gains no consistent benefit from exposure to failures during training.
items.title_ko: 가변 팀 규모 및 에이전트 손실 하의 다중 UAV 데이터 수집을 위한 심층 강화 학습
items.summary_ko: 이 연구는 무선 센서로부터 데이터를 수집하는 다중 무인 항공기(UAV) 팀을 위한 심층 강화 학습(MARL) 방법을 제시합니다. 가변적인 팀 규모와 에이전트 손실 상황에서도 분산형 조정 정책을 학습하여 원격 지역을 효율적이고 중복적으로 커버하는 것을 목표로 합니다.
items.why_ko: 다중 로봇 시스템이 실제 환경에서 직면할 수 있는 동적인 변화(팀원 이탈, 팀 규모 변경 등)에 강건하게 대응할 수 있는 강화 학습 전략을 개발하여, 드론 기반 데이터 수집 및 감시 시스템의 실용성을 높입니다.

items.title: Transferring Architecture as an Optimization Prior
items.body: Initialization determines the optimization "fate" of a model, going far beyond just setting the scale of its weights. It establishes a fundamental initial geometry over the input data, dictating certain aspects such as which examples are considered close and which representations gradient descent will naturally refine first. In this paper, we view the initial geometry of a network as an optimization prior and ask whether a network can change its optimization prior by referencing a completely different architecture. To investigate this question, we use an initialization procedure where a target network is aligned to the representational geometry of a randomly initialized guide network before any downstream training occurs. Crucially, alignment to the guide network cannot transfer learned features, never receives gradients, and does not use labels. We demonstrate that this cross-architecture transfer of "fate" benefits the target network in two key domains: (1) instilling the optimization benefits of depth into shallow networks by aligning them to deeper networks, and (2) transferring representational granularity by using fine-resolution networks to shape the geometry of networks with coarser representations. In both cases, the alignment results in improved downstream performance of the target network. Ultimately, this demonstrates that a model's architectural destiny can be decoupled from its physical structure and explicitly modified at initialization.
items.title_ko: 최적화 사전으로서 아키텍처 전이
items.summary_ko: 이 논문은 신경망의 초기화가 모델의 최적화 '운명'을 결정하며, 입력 데이터에 대한 근본적인 초기 기하학을 설정한다고 주장합니다. 네트워크의 초기 기하학을 최적화 사전(optimization prior)으로 간주하고, 완전히 다른 네트워크를 참조하여 최적화 사전을 변경할 수 있는지 묻습니다.
items.why_ko: 모델 초기화의 중요성을 재조명하고, 아키텍처 전이를 통해 모델의 최적화 경로를 유도하는 새로운 방법을 제시하여, 딥러닝 모델의 학습 효율성을 개선하는 데 기여합니다.

items.title: Solve Vision with Code: Coding Agents Are Stronger Visual Reasoners Than Video Models
items.body: Video generation models are increasingly evaluated as visual reasoners: given a first frame and a natural-language prompt, can the model produce the video in which the specified task is carried out? The paradigm is considered advantageous because the reasoning is native to the visual medium, unfolding directly in the frames rather than through language or code. Whether this native route is in fact the more reliable path to visual reasoning has not been tested against a symbolic alternative under the same conditions. We therefore pose the same tasks, with identical inputs, output specification and evaluator, to both media: rather than denoising pixels, a coding agent writes a program that renders the answer video, which an unmodified rule-based evaluator scores. On VBVR-Pro-Bench (Xu et al., 2026), a 500-instance suite spanning five cognitive categories with symbolic ground truth, the agent receives the same first frame and prompt as the video model, with no access to ground truth, metadata or generation models, and one attempt per instance. Three closed-model agents (Codex with gpt-6-astra, Claude Code with Fable 5.1 and Gemini CLI with Gemini 3.1 Pro) score 0.923, 0.894 and 0.893, each more than 0.22 above the strongest video model. Among 23 runnable open-weight models, the best, GLM-5, reaches 0.572, above all video models except the RL-trained one. Together, we show that for tasks whose solutions can be computed from a first frame and a prompt, program synthesis is currently a substantially more reliable route to visual reasoning than video generation. We further distinguish depictive programs, which navigate the image to recover a transferable scheme, from propositional programs, which operate on hard-coded values, revealing how visual reasoning unfolds in agent-written programs and what it implies for its nature of reasoning in general.
items.body_ko: 비디오 생성 모델은 시각적 추론기로서 점점 더 많이 평가되고 있습니다. 즉, 첫 번째 프레임과 자연어 프롬프트가 주어졌을 때, 모델이 지정된 작업을 수행하는 비디오를 생성할 수 있는가 하는 것입니다. 이러한 패러다임은 추론이 시각적 매체에 내재되어 언어나 코드를 통하는 대신 프레임 내에서 직접 전개되기 때문에 유리하다고 여겨집니다. 그러나 이 내재적 경로가 시각적 추론에 실제로 더 신뢰할 수 있는 경로인지는 동일한 조건에서 기호적 대안과 비교하여 테스트되지 않았습니다. 따라서 우리는 동일한 입력, 출력 사양 및 평가자를 사용하여 두 매체에 동일한 작업을 부여합니다. 픽셀을 디노이징하는 대신, 코딩 에이전트가 답변 비디오를 렌더링하는 프로그램을 작성하고, 수정되지 않은 규칙 기반 평가자가 점수를 매깁니다. 기호적 Ground Truth를 가진 5가지 인지 범주에 걸쳐 500개 인스턴스로 구성된 VBVR-Pro-Bench (Xu et al., 2026)에서, 에이전트는 비디오 모델과 동일한 첫 번째 프레임과 프롬프트를 받으며, Ground Truth, 메타데이터 또는 생성 모델에 접근할 수 없고, 인스턴스당 한 번의 시도만 허용됩니다. 세 가지 Closed-Model 에이전트(gpt-6-astra가 포함된 Codex, Fable 5.1이 포함된 Claude Code, Gemini 3.1 Pro가 포함된 Gemini CLI)는 각각 0.923, 0.894, 0.893점을 얻었으며, 이는 가장 강력한 비디오 모델보다 0.22 이상 높은 점수입니다. 실행 가능한 23개의 Open-Weight 모델 중 가장 좋은 GLM-5는 0.572점에 도달하여 RL 학습된 모델을 제외한 모든 비디오 모델보다 높습니다. 종합적으로 볼 때, 우리는 첫 번째 프레임과 프롬프트로부터 해결책을 계산할 수 있는 작업의 경우, 프로그램 합성이 현재 비디오 생성보다 시각적 추론에 훨씬 더 신뢰할 수 있는 경로임을 보여줍니다. 우리는 또한 이미지 내에서 이동하여 전이 가능한 스키마를 복구하는 Depictive Program과 하드코딩된 값으로 작동하는 Propositional Program을 구별하여, 에이전트가 작성한 프로그램에서 시각적 추론이 어떻게 전개되는지, 그리고 그것이 추론의 본질에 대해 일반적으로 무엇을 의미하는지 밝힙니다.
items.title_ko: 코드로 시각 문제 해결: 코딩 에이전트가 비디오 모델보다 강력한 시각 추론가
items.summary_ko: 이 연구는 비디오 생성 모델이 시각적 추론 작업에서 얼마나 잘 수행하는지, 그리고 코딩 에이전트가 더 나은 대안이 될 수 있는지를 탐구합니다. 코딩 에이전트가 비디오 모델보다 더 강력한 시각 추론 능력을 보여준다는 경험적 증거를 제시하며, 시각적 추론의 '자연스러운 경로'에 대한 기존 가정을 재평가합니다.
items.why_ko: AI의 시각적 추론에서 '언어/코드' 기반 접근 방식의 강력함을 보여주며, 복잡한 시각-언어 작업을 해결하는 새로운 패러다임을 제시하여 개발자들에게 새로운 영감을 줄 수 있습니다.

items.title: HOG-WAM: Improving Visual Robustness through Future Gradient Prediction
items.body: World-action models jointly predict future observations and actions, yet visual corruption can disrupt the resulting policies. We introduce HOG-WAM, which adds future Histograms of Oriented Gradients (HOG) as structural supervision derived directly from demonstration images. An auxiliary HOG diffusion transformer (DiT) module reads RGB features through asymmetric attention, allowing its objective to shape the visual representation used for control. The module is used only during training and removed at inference, preserving FastWAM's RGB-to-action architecture. We evaluate four controlled observation corruptions through a visual-corruption extension of RoboTwin, termed RoboTwin-Plus; HOG-WAM achieves the highest success among the compared policies under all four. Mixed-noise success increases from 78.86% to 82.86% relative to FastWAM, with comparable performance on clean scenes. On LIBERO Plus, overall success increases from 74.49% to 75.26%, with the largest gain under sensor noise, from 74.14% to 78.89%. Across four Franka tasks, average success increases from 40% to 59% under clean observations and from 17% to 24% under noisy observations. A representation ablation favors combining RGB observations with auxiliary HOG prediction over replacing RGB with HOG. These findings support future-gradient prediction as complementary supervision for visually robust control, with larger absolute gains on physical tasks than in simulation. Code is available at https://github.com/iPPLab/HOG-WAM.
items.title_ko: HOG-WAM: 미래 기울기 예측을 통한 시각적 강건성 향상
items.summary_ko: 이 논문은 월드-액션 모델(WAM)의 시각적 손상으로 인한 정책 왜곡 문제를 해결하기 위해 HOG-WAM을 소개합니다. 미래 HOG(Histograms of Oriented Gradients)를 시연 이미지에서 직접 파생된 구조적 감독으로 추가하여, 보조 HOG 확산 트랜스포머(DiT) 모듈을 통해 시각적 표현을 제어에 적합하게 형성합니다.
items.why_ko: 로봇이나 에이전트가 시각적 노이즈나 왜곡이 있는 환경에서도 강건하게 작동하도록 돕는 방법을 제시하여, 실제 환경에서의 AI 시스템 적용 안정성을 높이는 데 기여합니다.

items.title: Barron Smoothness for Layers in Deep Neural Networks
items.body: In order to bound approximation errors for deep neural networks, we split the problem into two steps: First the selection of optimal infinite width limits for each layer and second an optimal discretization of all layers to obtain finite sized networks. We show that in expectation, the latter problem is equivalently characterized by a layer wise generalization of Barron norms. Moreover, we provide an analysis of the optimization landscape and show that local minima are characterized by an equidistribution principle akin to similar ideas in adaptive spline and finite element approximation.
items.title_ko: 심층 신경망 레이어의 Barron Smoothness
items.summary_ko: 이 논문은 심층 신경망의 근사 오류를 제한하기 위해 각 레이어에 대한 최적의 무한 폭 한계와 모든 레이어의 최적 이산화를 다루는 2단계 접근 방식을 제시합니다. 후자의 문제는 Barron Norm의 레이어별 일반화를 통해 특성화될 수 있음을 보여줍니다.
items.why_ko: 심층 신경망의 이론적 이해를 심화하고, 모델의 근사 능력과 최적화 특성을 분석하는 데 필요한 수학적 도구를 제공합니다.

items.title: Guidance as Variance Matching
items.body: Guidance repels the prediction of a diffusion model away from a weaker reference prediction. It substantially improves sample quality, but its mechanism remains poorly understood. We first find that, at the scales used in practice, guidance does not improve the prediction of the posterior mean (the model's training target); it makes the prediction worse, while samples improve. Second, posterior-mean predictions have less variance than the data, and we find that guidance restores it. We introduce variance-matched guidance: a closed-form rule that picks the guidance scale by matching the variance of the guided predictions to that of the data. Without tuning, it recovers the hand-picked scales of eleven widely used models across image, video, audio, motion, and world generation; to our knowledge, no previous explanation of guidance predicts them. Applied per noise level, it yields a schedule without tuned hyperparameters that users prefer to hand-crafted ones on SD 3.5 Medium. Third, we offer an interpretation of the mechanism behind guidance: each model makes a random error in predicting the posterior mean, and guidance rescales the difference of these errors into a sample with the posterior's covariance, which improves sampling. This view also suggests two new hypotheses that our experiments support: guidance can work with negative scales, and guiding a model with its own checkpoint needs a larger scale than guiding it with an independently trained model.
items.title_ko: 분산 일치로서의 가이던스
items.summary_ko: 이 논문은 확산 모델(diffusion model)에서 샘플 품질을 크게 향상시키는 '가이던스(guidance)' 메커니즘을 심층적으로 분석합니다. 가이던스가 사후 평균 예측을 개선하기보다는, 예측의 분산을 데이터의 분산과 일치시키는 역할을 한다는 것을 발견했습니다. 이를 통해 새로운 가이던스 형식인 V-가이던스를 소개합니다.
items.why_ko: 확산 모델의 핵심 기술인 가이던스 메커니즘에 대한 새로운 이해를 제공하여, 고품질 이미지 및 비디오 생성 모델 개발에 중요한 이론적 및 실용적 기여를 합니다.

items.title: Split-RL: Local Conflict Resolution in Reinforcement Learning
items.body: Reinforcement learning (RL) policies are often trained by mixing contradictory feedback that is localized in space and time. For example, a robot may prioritize speed in open areas versus precision in tight gaps. We introduce Split-RL, a Gradient Boosting Trees (GBT) algorithm that uses guidance labels to locally isolate these conflicting signals. Standard neural networks (NNs) lack the structural mechanism to do this, as their parameters share feedback from all sources. While GBT provides the inductive bias to explicitly partition the state-space per objective, standard tree-fitting procedures aggregate contradictory gradient signals before they reach the leaves. Split-RL leverages this bias to integrate guidance labels into tree construction, routing these updates into disjoint state-space regions and preventing signal interference. Such labels can arise from heuristics, sensor-derived events, or existing rule-based systems, allowing Split-RL to incorporate rule-derived structure while retaining a learned policy. We theoretically show how early gradient aggregation loses objective-specific information and characterize when the Split-RL score isolates conflicting updates. We focus on constrained RL and offline RL with mixed datasets, each balancing two objectives that conflict locally. Across domains with spatial, rare-event, and temporal conflicts, Split-RL consistently outperforms existing methods by meeting the episodic cost budget while maintaining competitive rewards. In offline settings, Split-RL localizes the tradeoff between imitation and policy improvement, outperforming other methods and achieving near-expert performance across varying dataset sizes.
items.title_ko: Split-RL: 강화 학습에서의 지역 충돌 해결
items.summary_ko: 이 논문은 강화 학습(RL) 정책 훈련 시 시공간적으로 상충되는 피드백을 처리하는 문제를 다룹니다. Split-RL이라는 Gradient Boosting Trees (GBT) 알고리즘을 제안하여, 가이던스 레이블을 사용하여 이러한 충돌하는 신호를 로컬하게 분리하고 해결합니다. 이는 표준 신경망이 가진 한계를 극복합니다.
items.why_ko: 강화 학습 에이전트가 복잡하고 다양한 환경에서 일관되지 않은 보상 신호를 효과적으로 학습하도록 돕는 새로운 접근 방식을 제시하여, 더 유연하고 강건한 RL 정책 개발에 기여합니다.

items.title: PersonaFactory: Stylistic User Prompt Augmentation with Synthetic Persona Bank
items.body: Large language models increasingly replace real people in the AI development pipeline, as they are used to generate training dialogues at scale and to drive alignment and evaluation. However, out-of-the-box models produce monolingual and stylistically flat texts as synthetic user prompts, failing to replicate the real user-AI communication mechanics. We present PersonaFactory, an end-to-end pipeline that generates detailed user personas and uses them to augment existing user prompts from their point of view, producing a bank of over 740000 structured synthetic personas detailing their background and communication behaviors, and a corpus of roughly 1.24 million persona-styled synthetic conversations spanning 85 languages. We evaluate the effect of personal features on style adoption and intent preservation, using an LLM-judge and heuristic metrics to assess augmentation fidelity together with the downstream impact on assistant persona control through training data. Results show that our structured, attribute-based style representation enables per-axis control and better intent preservation at comparable style fidelity than free-text persona descriptions used in existing methods. A human expert evaluation found the augmented conversations plausible, with favorable ratings for intent preservation, style naturalness, and multilingual authenticity. Finally, PersonaFactory conversations achieve comparable performance to original training data on capability benchmarks, are preferred on real user prompts at equal reply length, and adapt their reply style more closely to users without explicit steering.
items.title_ko: PersonaFactory: 합성 페르소나 뱅크를 이용한 문체적 사용자 프롬프트 증강
items.summary_ko: 이 논문은 대규모 언어 모델(LLM) 개발 파이프라인에서 실제 사용자를 대체하는 'PersonaFactory'를 소개합니다. PersonaFactory는 상세한 사용자 페르소나를 생성하고 이를 사용하여 기존 사용자 프롬프트를 문체적으로 증강함으로써, 실제 사용자-AI 커뮤니케이션의 다양성을 재현하고자 합니다.
items.why_ko: LLM 훈련 데이터의 다양성과 현실성을 높여, 실제 사용자 시나리오에 더 잘 대응하고 사용자 경험을 개선할 수 있는 LLM을 개발하는 데 기여합니다.

items.title: Comparative Study of Deep Learning Architectures for Brain Tumour Classification
items.body: Accurate and early classification of brain tumours from magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) is essential for treatment planning, yet many published deep learning studies are trained and tested on small, single-source datasets, reporting accuracies that may not hold outside these datasets. This study compares six deep learning architectures for four-class classification (healthy, meningioma, glioma and pituitary tumour): a baseline convolutional neural network (CNN), an attention-based CNN, ShuffleNet, and EfficientNet-B0, ResNet-50 and Xception augmented with the Convolutional Block Attention Module (CBAM). The models were trained on a corpus assembled from four publicly available MRI datasets. Because these datasets carry no patient identifiers, a leakage-aware pipeline was developed that removes exact duplicates using MD5 hashing (550 images) and near-duplicates using perceptual hashing (8,024 images), and assigns visually similar images to the same fold during 5-fold group cross-validation. A leave-one-dataset-out (LODO) test on a fully held-out dataset was used to measure cross-dataset generalisation. Under a conventional random split, ShuffleNet achieved 97.1% accuracy with 1.2M parameters. Under leakage-aware group K-fold cross-validation, ShuffleNetV2 (98.41%) and EfficientNet-B0 (98.23%) were statistically indistinguishable (paired t-test, p = 0.19), and both significantly outperformed the custom CNNs. On the held-out dataset, accuracy dropped for every model: EfficientNet-B0 generalised best (78.4%), while ShuffleNetV2 fell to 66.2%. Glioma-meningioma confusion was the dominant error mode, and Grad-CAM maps showed that predictions were driven by tumour regions. These results indicate that in-distribution accuracy alone overstates real-world performance and that leakage-aware and cross-dataset evaluation should be reported alongside it.
items.title_ko: 뇌종양 분류를 위한 심층 학습 아키텍처 비교 연구
items.summary_ko: 이 연구는 자기공명영상(MRI) 기반 뇌종양(건강, 수막종, 교종, 뇌하수체 종양) 4등급 분류를 위한 6가지 심층 학습 아키텍처를 비교합니다. 소규모, 단일 소스 데이터셋에서 높은 정확도를 보고하는 기존 연구의 한계를 극복하기 위해 더 광범위한 평가를 수행합니다.
items.why_ko: 의료 AI 분야에서 뇌종양 진단 모델의 성능과 일반화 가능성을 체계적으로 평가하여, 실제 임상 환경에 적용 가능한 신뢰성 높은 모델 개발에 중요한 정보를 제공합니다.

items.title: Adaptive Reliability Reserves for Residential Battery Fleets
items.body: In a Houston 2024 replay, replacing a fixed 20 percent battery reserve with a county-risk threshold raises observed five-hour backup coverage from 75.0 percent to 86.5 percent and adds USD 10.2 in modeled annualized margin per home (paired 95 percent interval: USD +1.7 to USD +21.7). The paired coverage-gain interval includes zero. This is a conditional simulation result, not measured company reliability. Residential batteries face this tradeoff because market discharge consumes energy also needed for household outages. We release HomeFleet-ERCOT, combining observed prices and county outages with identified simulated homes and causal controller inputs. We compare independent-home optimization with 21 proximal policy optimization (PPO) training runs; ten promise-cost candidates span 31.1 percent-96.3 percent backup coverage. Of these, 10 have lower modeled margin than fixed 20 percent, and 3 also have lower coverage. Chronological, geographic, fleet, and storm tests examine transfer. An alert charging override has a conditional energy-and-power sufficiency guarantee, but only 19.5 percent of 41 county mass-outage episodes provide enough continuous warning for every battery preset. Synthetic tests include short, missed, and false warnings, load uplift, capacity loss, and dropout. A static AC audit retains existing feeder violations; aging comparisons expose model sensitivity. The released benchmark, controllers, and checkpoints provide a reproducible basis for comparing these tradeoffs. This work supports the design of residential battery programs that assess market value and household backup service together.
items.title_ko: 주거용 배터리 플릿을 위한 적응형 신뢰성 예비 전력
items.summary_ko: 이 연구는 고정된 20% 배터리 예비 전력을 지역 위험 임계값으로 대체함으로써 관찰된 5시간 백업 커버리지가 75.0%에서 86.5%로 증가하고, 가구당 연간 마진이 $10.2 증가함을 시뮬레이션으로 보여줍니다. 이는 주거용 배터리의 신뢰성 및 경제성을 향상시키는 방법론을 제시합니다.
items.why_ko: 에너지 관리 분야, 특히 분산형 에너지 시스템의 효율성과 신뢰성을 높이는 데 AI 및 최적화 기술이 어떻게 활용될 수 있는지 보여줍니다.

items.title: When Every Rollout Fails: Splicing Learner-Conditioned Options into Long-Horizon Agent RL
items.body: Group-based reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards often yields all-fail groups on long-horizon agent tasks: every sampled trajectory receives zero reward, leaving group-relative methods without a reward-based policy gradient. A common remedy supplies complete solutions from a stronger model, but full trajectories are expensive and expose the learner to long off-policy histories. We introduce SPLICE, which constructs local training targets from failed current-policy trajectories online. For each all-fail group, a proposal model selects a splice point in a current-policy trajectory and generates several bounded options from that point. We estimate each option's value using repeated current-policy continuations, convert positive estimates into a return-weighted local target, and fit the current policy on the options. We evaluate SPLICE across two policy families on two long-horizon agent tasks, Software Engineering with SWE-bench Verified and Deep Research with BrowseComp-Plus. SPLICE outperforms GRPO and full-trajectory guidance baselines in all four settings, improving over GRPO by 2.8--9.8 percentage points. On initially failed SWE tasks, it raises GRPO's graduation rate by 10.8 percentage points. Further experiments show that SPLICE improves performance while reducing costly proposal-model computation.
items.title_ko: 모든 롤아웃이 실패할 때: 장기 에이전트 RL에 학습자 조건부 옵션 접목
items.summary_ko: 이 논문은 장기 에이전트 작업에서 검증 가능한 보상 기반 강화 학습(RLVR)이 종종 '모든 롤아웃 실패' 상황에 직면하는 문제를 다룹니다. SPLICE라는 새로운 방법을 도입하여, 실패한 현재 정책 궤적에서 로컬 훈련 목표를 구성함으로써 이러한 한계를 극복합니다. 이는 전체 궤적 솔루션에 의존하는 기존 방법의 비효율성을 개선합니다.
items.why_ko: 장기 목표를 가진 AI 에이전트가 복잡한 환경에서 학습 효율성을 높일 수 있는 방법을 제시하여, 자율 에이전트 개발에 중요한 진전을 가져옵니다.

items.title: DFly2: Turbocharging Long-Context Speculative Decoding by Sharing the Target's Sparsity
items.body: To avoid the quadratic cost of dense attention over long contexts, models such as DeepSeek-V4 and Hy4 have turned natively sparse, and speculative decoding, which matters most where decoding is slowest, increasingly runs on them. Their drafters, however, still keep a context cache of their own, over the whole prompt or a sliding window. Beyond memory, such a cache costs prefill time, prefix-cache hits and decode concurrency. Drafters that read the target's cache avoid one of their own, but settle only which cache, not which positions, and still read everything or a recent window. Neither rule is made for the query at hand, and computing a selection per query in the drafter would cost more as the context grows. Yet a natively sparse target already picks positions for each query, over a cache it keeps anyway. Both of the drafter's choices are therefore already made, and paid for, by the target: its cache and its selection. We measure how far one selection carries: made a step early, it still covers close to nine tenths of what each later token selects on DS-V4.1-Flash. We present DFly2, a block-parallel drafter that shares the target's sparsity. Each draft layer reads the KV its paired target layer cached (KV sharing), at the positions that layer's indexer selected, a fixed number anywhere in the context (Index sharing). DFly2 thus runs no scoring pass and keeps no cache of its own. On DS-V4.1-Flash, GLM-5.3-Flash and Hy4~flash, whose sparse attention and architecture differ, it accepts more tokens per step than DFlash and DSpark trained on the same recipe, over general, long-context and agentic benchmarks. Its margin over the stronger baseline widens from 3.9%-10.5% on general workloads to 10.0%-31.5% on long-context and agentic ones. At high concurrency on DS-V4.1-Flash, at matched per-user decode speed, its throughput is 62% and 81% higher on two 64K sets.
items.title_ko: DFly2: 타겟의 희소성을 공유하여 긴 컨텍스트 추측 디코딩 터보차징
items.summary_ko: 이 논문은 긴 컨텍스트 추측 디코딩의 효율성을 높이기 위해 'DFly2'를 제안합니다. Dense attention의 이차 비용을 피하기 위해 DeepSeek-V4 및 Hy4와 같은 모델이 희소성(sparsity)을 활용하는 추세에 맞춰, Drafter가 Target의 캐시를 공유함으로써 자체 캐시를 유지할 필요 없이 메모리 및 전처리 시간을 절약합니다.
items.why_ko: 긴 컨텍스트를 처리하는 LLM의 디코딩 속도와 효율성을 획기적으로 향상시킬 수 있는 기술로, LLM 기반 애플리케이션의 실시간 성능 개선에 크게 기여할 것입니다.

items.title: Make the Adversary Spend More: Stateful Deception as a Cost-Exchange Primitive for AI-Era Cyber Defense
items.body: Large language models (LLMs) are transforming the economics of intrusion by reducing the attacker's cost to scan and adapt, while tempting defenders into unbounded compute. We argue that cyber deception should be judged by the cost exchange it imposes, not by realism or detection, and that the primitive making that exchange favorable is adversary-specific persistent state. Rather than a honeypot that resets or merges sessions, each recognized adversary re-enters the world it believes it has compromised, kept coherent with its own past actions and isolated from every other adversary, while the language model acts only as a constrained renderer of explicit state, never as its store. We formalize the trade-off as a Deception Exchange Rate (DER), relating mission-weighted adversary effort burned to defender resources spent, and instantiate it in an SSH honeypot pairing Cowrie with a local LLM. In this paper, we focus on the defender-side evaluation of that exchange, while specifying, but not yet measuring, per-adversary state and the adversary side of the DER. Across five open-weight models, deterministic-layer and prompt optimizations cut per-session defender cost by around 63% against a naive all-LLM decoy.
items.title_ko: 적에게 더 많은 비용을 지불하게 하라: AI 시대 사이버 방어를 위한 비용 교환 프리미티브로서의 상태 기반 기만
items.summary_ko: 이 논문은 대규모 언어 모델(LLM)이 공격자의 비용을 줄이는 반면 방어자를 무한한 컴퓨팅에 유혹하는 사이버 침투 경제학의 변화를 다룹니다. 사이버 기만(deception)을 현실성이나 탐지율이 아닌, '부과하는 비용 교환'의 관점에서 평가해야 하며, 이를 위한 핵심 원시 요소로 '적별 지속 상태'를 제시합니다.
items.why_ko: AI 기술의 발달로 인해 변화하는 사이버 보안 환경에서, 공격자의 비용을 증가시키는 방어 전략으로서의 AI 기만 기술 개발 방향을 제시하여, AI 기반 보안 시스템 설계에 중요한 통찰을 제공합니다.

items.title: When to Trust a PFN: Detecting Harmful Shift in Tabular Foundation Models
items.body: Tabular prior-fitted networks (PFNs) work well across tabular classification problems but can fail silently at deployment when distributions shift. We propose CALD (Calibrated Anchor-Loss Disagreement), a lightweight unsupervised monitor that triggers an alarm to warn when a PFN might fail. By finetuning the decoder to maximize disagreement with the test-set prediction while maintaining accuracy on an ID anchor set, CALD identifies harmful OOD batches through the resulting anchor loss, requiring no labels on test batches. We prove that the post-finetune anchor loss has a strictly lower expectation under sufficiently severe shift than under ID eval, yielding a one-sided test. Across 14 datasets covering tabular and structured distribution shift, on both TabPFN and TabICL, CALD matches or outperforms baselines on harmful shifts and is markedly more resilient to benign-shift false alarms.
items.title_ko: PFN을 언제 신뢰해야 하는가: 테이블 파운데이션 모델의 유해한 변화 감지
items.summary_ko: 이 논문은 테이블 사전 피팅 네트워크(PFN)가 배포 시 분포 변화로 인해 예측 불가능하게 실패할 수 있는 문제를 해결하기 위해 'CALD(Calibrated Anchor-Loss Disagreement)'라는 경량 비지도 모니터를 제안합니다. CALD는 디코더를 미세 조정하여 테스트 세트 예측과의 불일치를 최대화하고, ID 앵커 세트의 정확도를 유지함으로써 유해한 OOD(Out-Of-Distribution) 배치를 식별합니다.
items.why_ko: 테이블 파운데이션 모델의 배포 후 성능 저하를 조기에 감지하여, 모델의 신뢰성과 안정성을 높이는 데 기여합니다. 이는 금융, 의료 등 중요한 의사결정 분야의 AI 적용에 필수적입니다.

items.title: InterConRank: Joint Node Centrality in Interconnected Heterogeneous Networks
items.body: Two nodes with identical connections within their own layer can differ in importance if their neighbors in another layer occupy different positions in the network. We introduce InterConRank, a centrality algorithm that computes a separate node ranking for each layer of an interconnected network. Directed dependencies specify which layers supply scores to each receiving layer. InterConRank normalizes each type of link separately and updates all layers together, so a score can cross into a layer in one iteration and propagate along its internal links in the next. We prove convergence of this joint update and evaluate the resulting rankings on four scholarly networks. On all four networks, InterConRank gives the highest rank correlations with both h-index and total citations for nodes in the collaboration layer.
items.title_ko: InterConRank: 상호 연결된 이종 네트워크에서 공동 노드 중심성
items.summary_ko: 이 논문은 상호 연결된 이종 네트워크에서 각 레이어의 노드에 대한 개별 랭킹을 계산하는 중심성 알고리즘인 'InterConRank'를 소개합니다. 서로 다른 레이어의 노드들이 네트워크 내에서 차지하는 위치에 따라 중요도가 달라질 수 있음을 고려하여, 모든 레이어를 함께 업데이트하며 점수가 레이어를 넘나들 수 있도록 합니다.
items.why_ko: 복잡한 이종 네트워크에서 노드의 중요도를 보다 정확하게 측정하는 방법을 제시하여, 소셜 네트워크 분석, 생물학적 네트워크 연구 등 다양한 분야에 적용될 수 있습니다.

items.title: TASK Memory: Beyond Text-Only Memory with Activation Steering and Knowledge Editing against Memory Hallucination
items.body: LLM agents increasingly rely on external memory, yet they still hallucinate about what they remember. Often the correct memory is retrieved and placed in the prompt, but the answer contradicts it or the memory is applied to the wrong question. We call these use-time memory hallucinations. Across five open models, we find that they arise from the conflict between parametric knowledge and external memory and take three forms: memory-ignoring, where the model returns to a stale fact in its weights (up to 46% of queries); memory-misapplying, where it attributes the memory to unrelated entities (up to 24%, and 49% when retrieval is combined with weight editing); and version confusion, where 53% of answers about revised facts assert the superseded value when both versions remain stored. We propose TASK memory, which goes beyond text-only memory by combining a Text note with Activation Steering and Knowledge editing that share one in-model address. The text holds the content. A removable knowledge edit supplies the address through its subject key and supports multi-hop composition. A pair of steering vectors decides, query by query, whether the model adopts the memory or keeps its own answer; the vectors store no content and control how the text memory is used. On frozen models under a pre-registered, test-once protocol, TASK reduces memory-ignoring hallucinations to at most 1.5% in all ten model-dataset cells and cuts neighbour misuse from 39.2% to 7.5% (+10.8 pp composite on CounterFact). It improves a 300-memory library over BM25 RAG by 16.4 pp, an advantage that holds at 3,000 memories, resolves fact revisions without fact IDs, and adds 7.5 pp of multi-hop accuracy on MQuAKE. 21 of 23 cross-model comparisons (8B-27B, four families) are significant, and TASK beats three recent context-steering methods in 9 of 10 model-dataset cells.
items.title_ko: TASK Memory: 활성화 조종 및 지식 편집을 통한 텍스트 전용 메모리 환각 극복
items.summary_ko: 이 논문은 LLM 에이전트가 외부 메모리에 대해 환각을 일으키는 문제를 다룹니다. '사용 시점 메모리 환각(use-time memory hallucinations)'이라는 개념을 도입하여, 모델의 파라미터 지식과 외부 메모리 간의 충돌에서 이러한 환각이 발생함을 분석합니다. 이를 해결하기 위해 활성화 조종(Activation Steering) 및 지식 편집(Knowledge Editing) 기술을 제안합니다.
items.why_ko: LLM 에이전트의 기억 관련 환각 문제를 해결하고, 외부 지식 기반을 더 효과적으로 활용하도록 돕는 중요한 연구로, LLM의 신뢰성과 유용성을 크게 향상시킬 수 있습니다.

items.title: One Model, Many Modes: Evolving System Prompt Ensembles for Creative Generation
items.body: Preference-aligned LLMs can exhibit mode collapse, concentrating their output distributions around a narrow set of high-reward responses. This limits creative generation, which requires quality, novelty, and diversity. Existing test-time methods often emphasize diversity, giving less attention to whether individual responses are both high-quality and novel. This distinction matters in practical use, where users may seek a single compelling, original response. We formalize creative generation as a multi-objective distributional optimization problem and introduce SEPO, a training-free framework for System Prompt Ensemble Optimization. The framework combines prompt evolution with greedy max-min selection to identify behaviorally distinct system prompts under a quality constraint, then uniformly samples one prompt per response at inference time. Across four creative generation tasks with increasing quality requirements and three open-weight models, SEPO ranks first in 8 of 12 settings on the harmonic mean of quality, diversity, and novelty, while no baseline leads in more than two. On average, it raises LLM-judged diversity from 1.92 to 3.43 and novelty from 1.00 to 3.34 over base sampling (1-5 scale), with quality decreasing from 3.72 to 3.30. We further show that expanding the optimized ensemble increases separation among prompt-conditioned response distributions. These results support system prompt ensemble optimization as a promising approach to improving LLM creativity at inference time.
items.title_ko: 하나의 모델, 여러 모드: 창의적 생성을 위한 시스템 프롬프트 앙상블 진화
items.summary_ko: 이 논문은 선호도 정렬된 LLM이 '모드 붕괴(mode collapse)' 현상으로 인해 창의적 생성에서 다양성을 잃는 문제를 다룹니다. 품질, 참신성, 다양성을 모두 요구하는 창의적 생성을 위해 '시스템 프롬프트 앙상블'을 진화시키는 방법을 제안합니다.
items.why_ko: LLM이 더 다양하고 독창적인 결과물을 생성하도록 유도하는 방법을 제시하여, AI 기반 창의적 콘텐츠 생성 및 디자인 분야의 발전에 기여합니다.

items.title: Reading Fine-Tuning Diffs Through Lenses: Model Diffing for Backdoor Detection
items.body: We introduce a common scoring system based on token readouts to evaluate weight, activation and output-based model diffing methods for backdoor detection in fine-tuning processes. We also improve existing weight and activation based methods by incorporating the $J$-lens and its refinement, the $J{+}{+}$-lens. We test our setup in experiments where we compare a backdoored model with the base model from which it was fine-tuned. Our results show that incorporating the $J{+}{+}$-lens improves the weight-based method in all our settings, while the $J$-lens improves its ranks within single layers. The strongest single method is $ΔW J{+}{+}$, the weight difference decoded through the $J{+}{+}$-lens of the base model, which ranks a token naming the backdoor among its first ten tokens in 11 of our 12 settings. Moreover, we show that output and activation based methods such as ADL and Diff Mining can easily break if the backdoored model is penalised during fine-tuning for giving the backdoor's words probability on clean inputs, whereas the weight-based methods are not affected. Conversely, permuting the hidden units or training only the layers that read the residual stream hides the backdoor from the weight-based methods but not from ADL and Diff Mining. No single method resists both attacks.
items.title_ko: 렌즈를 통해 파인튜닝 차이점 읽기: 백도어 탐지를 위한 모델 Diffing
items.summary_ko: 이 논문은 파인튜닝 과정에서 백도어 탐지를 위한 모델 diffing(차이점 분석) 방법에 대해 토큰 판독(token readout) 기반의 공통 점수 시스템을 소개합니다. 기존 가중치 및 활성화 기반 diffing 방법을 $J$-렌즈 및 $J{++}$-렌즈 개념을 통합하여 개선합니다.
items.why_ko: AI 모델의 보안 취약점, 특히 백도어 공격을 효과적으로 탐지하는 방법을 제시하여, AI 시스템의 신뢰성과 안전성을 확보하는 데 중요한 기술적 진보입니다.

items.title: Collect for Coverage, Replay with Evidence: Adaptive and Efficient On-Policy Distillation for Long-Horizon Agents
items.body: Fully online on-policy distillation (OPD) is costly for long-horizon agents because each update depends on fresh environment rollouts. Prefix replay offers an efficient alternative by sampling current-student responses from stored histories, reducing idle time for long-tail rollouts and allowing each collected trajectory to support multiple updates. However, our analysis of the complete prefix replay pipeline identifies two limitations in long-horizon settings. In trajectory collection, teacher-only trajectories miss student-induced histories, while broader history coverage can reduce teacher reliability. In trajectory reuse, fixed position-based schedules cannot identify critical decisions that may occur at any trajectory depth. We introduce CARE-OPD (Collect for coverAge, Replay with Evidence) to address both limitations. Student-seeded teacher completions and response-level confidence gating expand history coverage while filtering unreliable updates. Hindsight replay allocation then uses downstream execution evidence to select consequential turns. Across long-horizon tasks Software Engineering and Deep Research, CARE-OPD outperforms online OPD and prior prefix replay baselines. On SWE-bench Verified, it raises task success to 59.5% while reducing end-to-end training time by 45% and environment actions by 44% relative to asynchronous online OPD.
items.title_ko: 커버리지를 위한 수집, 증거를 위한 재생: 장기 에이전트를 위한 적응적이고 효율적인 On-Policy 증류
items.summary_ko: 이 논문은 장기 에이전트를 위한 완전 온라인 On-Policy 증류(OPD)의 높은 비용 문제를 해결합니다. Prefix replay를 통해 저장된 기록에서 현재 학생 모델의 응답을 샘플링하여 효율성을 높이지만, 긴 시퀀스 설정에서 이 방법의 두 가지 한계를 분석하고 개선 방향을 제시합니다.
items.why_ko: 장기 목표를 가진 강화 학습 에이전트의 학습 효율성을 높이는 방법을 제시하여, 복잡한 환경에서 AI 에이전트의 훈련 비용을 절감하고 성능을 향상시키는 데 기여합니다.

items.title: What Is a Theory Worth to an LLM Solver? Measuring, Inducing, and Merging Theories in Context
items.body: Mathematicians solve problems faster when they know the right theory. We ask how much a stated theory is worth to a large language model (LLM) solver, and whether a model can write that theory itself. In a length-matched protocol, adding the right theory to the context of Qwen3-14B raises pass@1 on pattern waiting-time problems from 0.37 to 0.83 and cuts the median tokens of correct solutions from 10.2k to 6.3k, while worked examples of the same length do not help. The gain shrinks as the solver and its token budget grow (+0.46, +0.26, +0.07), and at a long budget it comes almost entirely from finishing within budget: solutions that finish are correct 98--100\% of the time in every condition. To separate induction from recall, we plant unpublished theorems in custom probability families and measure how much of the oracle theory's gain an induced theory recovers. A strong open model, required to explore the training problems with code before writing, recovers 60\% of the gain on one planted family, 48\% on a second, and almost none on a third, where it finds the right form but not the condition that makes the form computable. No single induced note is complete, but a strong model that merges several notes recovers 61\% of the gain on the classic family, above the best single note (47\%). Theories are worth the reasoning they save, and models can find their pieces before they can assemble them.
items.body_ko: 수학자들은 올바른 이론을 알 때 문제를 더 빨리 해결합니다. 우리는 LLM(대규모 언어 모델) 해결사에게 명시된 이론이 얼마나 가치 있는지, 그리고 모델이 스스로 그 이론을 작성할 수 있는지 묻습니다. 길이 일치 프로토콜에서, Qwen3-14B의 컨텍스트에 올바른 이론을 추가하면 패턴 대기 시간 문제에서 pass@1이 0.37에서 0.83으로 증가하고, 올바른 솔루션의 중간 토큰이 10.2k에서 6.3k로 줄어드는 반면, 같은 길이의 예제는 도움이 되지 않습니다. 이득은 해결사와 토큰 예산이 증가함에 따라 줄어들고(+0.46, +0.26, +0.07), 긴 예산에서는 거의 전적으로 예산 내에서 완료하는 데서 나옵니다. 솔루션이 완료되면 모든 조건에서 98-100%의 정확도를 보입니다. 귀납과 회상을 분리하기 위해, 우리는 사용자 정의 확률 분포에 미출판된 정리를 심고, 유도된 이론이 오라클 이론의 이득을 얼마나 회복하는지 측정합니다. 강력한 Open 모델은 작성 전에 코드를 사용하여 훈련 문제를 탐색해야 하며, 한 심어진 분포에서 이득의 60%를, 두 번째 분포에서는 48%를 회복하지만, 세 번째 분포에서는 거의 회복하지 못합니다. 여기서 모델은 올바른 형식을 찾았지만, 형식을 계산 가능하게 만드는 조건은 찾지 못했습니다. 단일 유도 노트는 완전하지 않지만, 여러 노트를 병합하는 강력한 모델은 고전적인 분포에서 이득의 61%를 회복하며, 이는 최고의 단일 노트(47%)보다 높습니다. 이론은 아끼는 추론만큼 가치 있으며, 모델은 이론을 조립하기 전에 그 조각을 찾을 수 있습니다.
items.title_ko: 이론은 LLM 해결사에게 얼마나 가치 있는가? 컨텍스트 내 이론 측정, 유도 및 병합
items.summary_ko: 이 연구는 대규모 언어 모델(LLM) 해결사에게 '이론'이 얼마나 가치 있는지를 탐구합니다. Qwen3-14B 모델 실험에서 적절한 이론을 컨텍스트에 추가하는 것만으로 문제 해결 정확도가 0.37에서 0.83으로 향상되고, 정답 솔루션의 토큰 수가 감소함을 보여줍니다.
items.why_ko: LLM의 문제 해결 능력을 획기적으로 향상시키는 데 '이론적 지식'의 중요성을 입증하며, LLM이 단순히 패턴을 학습하는 것을 넘어, 지식을 통합하고 활용하는 방향으로 진화할 수 있음을 시사합니다.

items.title: BRIAR: Martingale Belief Smoothing on Bifurcation-Guided Reasoning Trees
items.body: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has rapidly advanced long-chain reasoning, yet standard policy optimizers distribute rollout compute and gradient credit blindly across a trajectory. On hard problems, an early misstep derails the remaining trace, whereas on solvable problems, the policy keeps generating redundant verification long after the answer is already determined. We trace both pathologies to a single structural fact: under an on-policy verifier, the true prefix pass probability $V^π(u)$ along a reasoning trace forms a $[0,1]$-bounded Doob martingale whose learnable credit variance is strictly conserved and bounded above by $V^π(u)(1-V^π(u))$, vanishing at both the derailed ($V^π\to 0$) and absorbed ($V^π\to 1$) boundaries. We introduce BRIAR (Bifurcation-guided Rollout and Inference on Adaptive Reasoning trees), a tree-structured RLVR framework built directly around this martingale geometry. First, BRIAR expands discourse-aligned reasoning trees along an upper-confidence outcome-bifurcation frontier, steering rollouts away from absorbed rumination and toward unresolved decision points. Second, it models latent node values with boundary-scaled heteroscedastic edge variances and computes exact global posteriors in linear $\mathcal{O}(|V|)$ time via two-pass Rauch--Tung--Striebel (RTS) tree belief smoothing, eliminating $\mathcal{O}(m^3)$ matrix inversions while gating out spurious boundary noise. Third, BRIAR detects minimal absorbed frontier nodes and applies zero-sum log-length centered suffix advantages strictly post-absorption, leaving pre-absorption derivations provably invariant.
items.title_ko: BRIAR: 분기 유도 추론 트리의 Martingale 신념 스무딩
items.summary_ko: 이 논문은 검증 가능한 보상 기반 강화 학습(RLVR)에서 발생하는 '초기 오판' 및 '불필요한 중복 검증' 문제를 다룹니다. BRIAR이라는 방법을 통해, 온-폴리시 검증기 하에서 참된 접두사 통과 확률이 항상 증가하거나 감소하는 특성인 'Martingale 속성'을 활용하여 추론 트리를 최적화합니다.
items.why_ko: LLM 기반의 장기 추론 에이전트가 복잡한 문제 해결 과정에서 발생할 수 있는 비효율성을 줄이고, 추론 과정을 최적화하여 성능을 향상시키는 데 기여합니다.

items.title: How Well Do Vision-Language Scene Graphs Serve as Memory for Embodied Question Answering?
items.body: Embodied QA needs memory, but answer accuracy mixes retained evidence, reading errors and question priors. For a simulated multi-room scene-graph pipeline we define answerability: the fraction of questions a fixed rule-based reader answers correctly from the graph alone. The baseline recovers 24.1% of visible object types and its room labels flicker. Four targeted repairs double recall, raise answerability from 27.2% to 37.4%, and improve retrained QA from 71.4% to 75.9%, yet better object F1 can lower answerability. A question-type prior beats this reader on every predicted graph. In one real-video test, graph memory lowers accuracy. These exploratory findings favour scoring retained evidence alongside accuracy.
items.title_ko: Vision-Language Scene Graphs가 embodied Question Answering의 메모리 역할을 잘 수행하는가?
items.summary_ko: 이 연구는 시각-언어 장면 그래프(Vision-Language Scene Graphs)가 embodied Question Answering(QA) 시스템의 메모리 역할을 얼마나 잘 수행하는지 평가합니다. 시뮬레이션된 다중 방 장면 그래프 파이프라인에서 '답변 가능성(answerability)'을 정의하고, 객체 인식 및 장면 레이블링 오류가 QA 성능에 미치는 영향을 분석합니다.
items.why_ko: embodied AI 시스템의 핵심 구성 요소인 메모리(장면 그래프)의 한계를 분석하고 개선 방안을 제시하여, 로봇의 환경 이해 및 질문 답변 능력 향상에 기여합니다.

items.title: Was the Model Given the Right Action? Auditing and Repairing Action Interfaces in Navigation World Models
items.body: World models are evaluated by predicting future observations from actions. These evaluations assume that actions are prepared the same way as during training, but an unchecked mismatch can make a model appear less accurate than it is. We audit this assumption in Navigation World Models (NWM) and find three interacting differences between its training and rollout code. Correcting the inputs, without retraining, reduces mean visual prediction error by 42%, measured with DreamSim on the RECON navigation dataset. The correction also changes the ranking of NWM checkpoints in an exploratory analysis and removes or reduces two alternative models' measured advantages. Correcting only the normalization offset instead increases error, showing why interacting mismatches must be checked together. To test whether sensitivity to input preparation extends beyond NWM, we deliberately introduce encoding errors into two alternative models; both become less accurate. We introduce ActRosetta, a tool that checks whether action encoding matches training, identifies supported causes of disagreement, and repairs inputs when sufficient information is available. Repair helps little where predictions barely respond to actions, the tool's diagnosis has limited coverage, and improved control remains unproven. For any action-conditioned world model, the lesson is the same: before reporting rollout error, verify that evaluation encodes actions exactly as training did.
items.title_ko: 모델에 올바른 액션이 주어졌는가? 내비게이션 월드 모델의 액션 인터페이스 감사 및 복구
items.summary_ko: 이 연구는 내비게이션 월드 모델(NWM)의 훈련과 롤아웃 코드 사이의 액션 인터페이스 불일치 문제를 감사하고 복구합니다. 입력값을 수정하는 것만으로 재훈련 없이 평균 시각 예측 오류를 42% 줄일 수 있음을 보여주며, 이는 모델의 실제 정확도보다 낮게 평가될 수 있음을 시사합니다.
items.why_ko: 로봇 내비게이션 월드 모델의 정확한 평가와 성능 최적화를 위해 액션 인터페이스의 중요성을 강조하며, AI 시스템 개발 시 미묘한 구현 차이가 큰 영향을 미칠 수 있음을 보여줍니다.

items.title: From NP-Hardness to Exact Tractability Through Sample Abundance
items.body: Additional observations can make exact optimization tractable without changing the objective or feasible set. We establish this phenomenon for noisy parity fitting, a worst-case NP-hard problem, with uniformly sampled rank-one sign tensor entries, independent fair factor signs and independent errors. For fixed interaction order $k\ge3$, $n$ signs per block, logarithmic mean degree and known channel biases, $O(n/(\log n)^{1/(k-2)})$ further readings of the same source suffice with high probability for exact optimization in $O(n\log^2 n)$ worst-case work. The leading coefficient is sharp for weak recovery by depth-$O(\log\log n)$ local estimators with independent reading marks. A common signed-field law determines the gain over the generating source, the number of tied optima and the dimension needed for later reweightings. The geometry of the remaining coordinates determines the sharp radius of local verification for high-scoring assignments with high probability.
items.title_ko: 샘플 풍부함을 통한 NP-난해성에서 정확한 가용성으로
items.summary_ko: 이 논문은 노이즈가 있는 패리티 피팅(noisy parity fitting)과 같이 최악의 경우 NP-난해한 문제도 '샘플 풍부함(sample abundance)'을 통해 정확한 최적화가 가능해질 수 있음을 보여줍니다. 추가적인 관측값이 객관 함수나 실행 가능한 집합을 변경하지 않고도 정확한 최적화를 가능하게 함을 입증합니다.
items.why_ko: 복잡한 최적화 문제에서 데이터의 양이 이론적인 난이도를 극복하고 효율적인 해결책을 가능하게 할 수 있음을 시사하여, AI 모델 훈련 및 최적화 전략 수립에 새로운 관점을 제공합니다.

items.title: Hierarchical Graph Metanetworks
items.body: The emerging field of weight space learning has demonstrated the potential to enable metanetworks, i.e. models that process neural network (NN) data, to support several steps of the machine learning lifecycle, from model optimisation to evaluation and adaptation. However, this potential has yet to materialise beyond small-scale MLPs or CNNs: most current models, including message-passing based graph metanetworks (GMNs), operate exclusively at the finest level of granularity, processing every neuron and weight of the input model. Their cost therefore scales with the number of parameters. Yet NNs are inherently organised hierarchically, with neurons forming layers and layers forming blocks and modules. Additionally, several of their properties, such as Lipschitz upper bounds and generalisation measures, are compositions of layer- and block-level quantities. To incorporate this inductive bias, we introduce Hierarchical Graph Metanetworks (H-GMNs), which leverage the input architecture's hierarchy to coarsen and refine the graph using permutation-symmetry-preserving pooling and un-pooling layers. Further, we extend H-GMNs to Transformers by introducing a graph construction that preserves permutation symmetries and enables multi-level pooling. Our evaluation includes new ResNet-18, ViT and varying ViT model zoos of up to 86M parameters, on tasks spanning model evaluation (an analytic Lipschitz bound proxy, generalisation and robustness prediction), testing (backdoor detection) and editing (pruning). Experimental results show that, compared to non-equivariant alternatives and flat GMNs, H-GMNs are markedly more sample-efficient, and their cost remains nearly constant as metanetwork depth grows, allowing deeper and more expressive processing where flat GMNs run out of memory, without compromising accuracy, which in certain cases considerably improves.
items.title_ko: 계층적 그래프 메타네트워크
items.summary_ko: 이 논문은 메타네트워크(metanetwork) 분야에서 신경망(NN) 데이터를 처리하여 모델 최적화, 평가 및 적응을 지원하는 잠재력을 탐구합니다. 현재 모델들이 미세한 단위에서만 작동하는 한계를 지적하며, 계층적 그래프 메타네트워크의 개념을 제안합니다.
items.why_ko: 작은 규모의 모델을 넘어 대규모 신경망에서도 메타 학습 및 메타네트워크 기술을 적용할 수 있는 새로운 아키텍처 방향을 제시합니다.

items.title: Bigger Model or Bigger Table? How Much Backbone a Chorus N-gram Module Replaces
items.body: We ask how much of a transformer's backbone the Chorus N-gram module replaces. Chorus adds hashed tables of token bigrams and trigrams to its input and attention. We train models of 16M to 349M parameters on 1.34 billion tokens of Polish printed before 1918 and find the size of a plain model with the same held-out loss. A separate learning-rate search for each kind of model cuts Chorus's gain at 47M by about a third. With tables about as large as the backbone, Chorus then matches a plain model 1.34 times its size at 16M and 1.16 to 1.20 times from 107M to 349M. With these tables, each added parameter replaces at most 0.31 backbone parameters. Chorus trains slower than a plain model of its size and faster than one of the same loss. On a fact quiz the two differ about as much as two seeds of one model. The results rest on one corpus, one 8,000-token vocabulary and a fifth of an epoch.
items.title_ko: 더 큰 모델인가 더 큰 테이블인가? 코러스 N-그램 모듈이 백본을 얼마나 대체하는가?
items.summary_ko: 이 연구는 Chorus N-그램 모듈이 Transformer의 백본 중 얼마나 많은 부분을 대체할 수 있는지 질문합니다. Chorus는 토큰 바이그램과 트라이그램의 해시 테이블을 입력 및 어텐션에 추가하며, 1.34억 개의 폴란드어 토큰으로 훈련된 모델 실험을 통해 그 효과를 측정합니다.
items.why_ko: LLM의 효율성과 성능 향상을 위해 모델 아키텍처에 N-그램 테이블을 통합하는 새로운 접근 방식을 제시하여, 언어 모델의 설계 최적화에 기여합니다.

items.title: LiDAR Intensity Reconstruction with Limited Real Data: An Architecture Benchmark under Fixed-Epoch Training
items.body: Physics-derived simulation can supplement scarce real-world LiDAR intensity measurements, but its effectiveness depends on the learning architecture and the amount of real training data available. We benchmark nine neural architectures for LiDAR intensity reconstruction from depth, semantic labels, incidence angle, and material reflectance, using real SemanticKITTI and synthetic VoxelScape range-image data. All models follow a fixed 20-epoch protocol; this controls the number of training passes, not the computational cost across architectures. We report mean absolute error (MAE), mean squared error (MSE), peak signal-to-noise ratio (PSNR), structural similarity (SSIM), inference timing, and spectral-energy agreement. We also evaluate four selected architectures with fixed-size training mixtures containing 0\%, 1\%, 5\%, 10\%, 20\%, 50\%, or 100\% real frames. With real-only training, UNet-V2 achieves the best reported reconstruction metrics (MAE 0.234, MSE 0.140, PSNR 8.64 dB, and SSIM 0.647), followed by a denoising diffusion model (DDPM). In several mixtures containing 1--10\% real data, DDPM achieves lower error and higher image-quality metrics than the evaluated deterministic alternatives, whereas UNet-V2 leads with 100\% real data. Spectral analysis additionally reveals architecture-dependent discrepancies across frequency bands. These findings characterize reconstruction trade-offs under the stated data mixtures and fixed-epoch protocol, without establishing compute-matched superiority or isolating the diffusion objective from backbone differences.
items.title_ko: 제한된 실제 데이터로 LiDAR 강도 재구성: 고정 Epoch 훈련 하의 아키텍처 벤치마크
items.summary_ko: 이 연구는 제한된 실제 LiDAR 데이터 환경에서 LiDAR 강도 재구성을 위한 9가지 신경 아키텍처를 벤치마킹합니다. 물리 기반 시뮬레이션 데이터와 실제 SemanticKITTI, VoxelScape 데이터를 사용하여 고정된 20 epoch 훈련 프로토콜 하에서 각 모델의 성능을 비교합니다.
items.why_ko: 자율 주행 및 로봇 공학에서 LiDAR 데이터 처리의 중요한 문제인 데이터 부족 문제를 해결하고, 실제 환경에서 강건하게 작동하는 LiDAR 시스템 개발에 기여합니다.

items.title: Robust Recourse under Causal Graph Ambiguity
items.body:
Causal algorithmic recourse recommends actions to reverse unfavorable decisions by modeling how interventions change an individual's features. Existing methods typically assume one causal graph that describes the system and account for uncertainty in the causal mechanisms. However, there usually exist several graphs that fit the same data but can predict different effects for the same action. Certain actions may achieve recourse across multiple graphs, but as the set of potential graphs grows, a single best action may become infeasible.
We propose Worst-Case Recourse and Graph-Weighted Recourse to find a low-cost action that succeeds across all candidate graphs or a specified fraction of graph weight, respectively. Assuming a set of plausible graphs, for each graph we fit Gaussian process structural equations and assess success using the posterior mean--standard-deviation criterion. We use gradient-based search to determine minimal cost actions and check the validity of the actions on fresh posterior samples. In synthetic and semi-synthetic benchmarks, relaxing robustness, the requirement that an action succeed under every candidate graph, can increase the number of valid recommendations for recourse and lower costs of actions for both methods. In the 20-node GP benchmark, relaxation increases the number of factual instances offered recourse (coverage) from 341 to 436 out of 1,000, while the number of true successes, actions that flip the decision under the generating model, falls from 251 to 184, illustrating the coverage--validity trade-off. Accounting for graph ambiguity can help decision-makers recommend actions that remain effective even when the causal mechanisms of the system are not fully known.
items.title_ko: 인과 그래프 모호성 하의 강건한 교정
items.summary_ko: 이 논문은 인과 그래프가 여러 개 존재할 수 있는 상황에서 알고리즘적 교정(algorithmic recourse)의 강건성 문제를 다룹니다. 기존 방법들이 단일 인과 그래프를 가정하는 한계를 지적하며, 여러 잠재적 그래프에 걸쳐 교정을 달성할 수 있는 '강건한 교정' 개념을 제시합니다.
items.why_ko: AI 시스템의 의사결정에 대한 공정성과 책임성을 높이기 위해, 잠재적인 인과 관계의 불확실성 속에서도 사용자에게 효과적인 교정을 제공하는 방법을 제시합니다.

items.title: Privileged On-Policy Distillation for Calibrated Alzheimer's Diagnosis With Missing Modalities
items.body: Alzheimer's disease is diagnosed from clinical, biospecimen and imaging evidence, but few patients undergo every test. Because these modalities are complementary, a missing one has many plausible values. Most existing methods leave it out or train on one estimate, so their classifier never sees its other values, and the estimate is never checked against the diagnosis. We address both gaps with on-policy distillation: the model fills in the missing modalities itself, and teachers with information available only in training grade these fills. Our method, Graded Rollout Imputation with Privileged teachers, draws several fills, one modality at a time. An imputation teacher that knows the diagnosis grades each step, bringing the outcome into the imputation as statistical practice recommends. A diagnosis teacher that sees all real modalities supplies a soft target. Trained on fills that vary, the model learns a confidence that reflects what the missing tests leave open, and it diagnoses from a single rollout. On the Alzheimer's Disease Neuroimaging Initiative cohort, it outperforms state-of-the-art baselines. On two external cohorts, it remains competitive in discrimination and, even after every method is recalibrated, its calibration error is level with the lowest on both. Added to three of these baselines, the teachers improve each of them. Our method offers a single, well-calibrated model for whatever combination of tests a patient has received.
items.title_ko: 누락된 양식을 통한 보정된 알츠하이머 진단을 위한 Privileged On-Policy 증류
items.summary_ko: 이 논문은 알츠하이머병 진단 시 누락된 임상, 생체 시료, 영상 양식(modality) 문제를 해결하기 위해 'Privileged On-Policy 증류' 방법을 제안합니다. 모델이 스스로 누락된 양식을 채우고, 정보가 풍부한 교사 모델이 진단에 대해 검증하여 불일치를 보정합니다.
items.why_ko: 의료 AI 분야에서 데이터 부족 및 불완전성 문제를 해결하고, 여러 양식의 정보를 통합하여 알츠하이머병 진단의 정확도와 신뢰성을 높이는 데 기여합니다.

items.title: Spec2Weights: Certifying Networks that a Language Model Writes from a Specification
items.body: A language model can write the weights of a small MLP, CNN, RNN or GNN from a plain-language specification, with no data and no gradient step. We ask when such a network can be proved exact in the float32 arithmetic it actually runs in. A float-safety lemma makes exhaustive float32 enumeration a proof for any summation order, and a layered error bound covers networks whose weights are not short binary fractions. With dynamic programming, template checks, an SMT proof, breadth-first search and induction for weight-tied recurrences, this certifies 12 of 15 written networks (one after a single constant fix) on every input of a stated domain (up to $10^{16}$ inputs, or every graph or grid up to a size bound), in a minute of CPU or less each. The certificates also say where a network stops being exact: the shortest-path network is exact iff the distance is at most 4,096 and fails at the predicted hops. Thirty new specifications were each written by a fresh session of one model family (Claude Opus 5.5). Twenty-five first submissions are certified exact for any summation order; the five tax schedules stay within \$0.11 of the true tax at every whole dollar in one fixed float32 run. An open 27B model passes 23 of the 30, and 25 with more thinking and code execution, so the method transfers in part. We also prove two limits of learning from examples: input coordinates never active in training cannot be learned from more in-range data, and Luhn-type checksums have exponentially small target-dependent gradient variance across their family. Tuned gradient descent on the same architectures agrees with both, which cover two of our five failure classes.
items.title_ko: Spec2Weights: 언어 모델이 명세서에서 작성하는 네트워크 인증
items.summary_ko: 이 연구는 대규모 언어 모델(LLM)이 데이터나 기울기 업데이트 없이 평범한 언어 명세서로부터 작은 MLP, CNN, RNN 또는 GNN의 가중치를 작성할 수 있음을 보여줍니다. 이러한 네트워크가 float32 연산에서 '정확함'을 증명할 수 있는 조건을 탐구하며, float-안전성 보조정리를 제시합니다.
items.why_ko: LLM이 코드 생성에 이어 모델 가중치까지 직접 생성하고, 그 정확성을 수학적으로 증명할 수 있는 가능성을 제시하여, AI 기반 자동화된 모델 개발 및 검증의 새로운 지평을 엽니다.

items.title: From Shared Patterns to Individual Evidence: Two-Stage Reasoning for Emerging Entities in Temporal Knowledge Graphs
items.body: Temporal knowledge graphs (TKGs) continually introduce emerging entities whose interaction histories evolve from zero-shot debuts into sparse, bursty few-shot trajectories. However, current paradigms are fragmented: pattern-transfer methods lack catalog-wide event memory, whereas online memory models suffer from endpoint-role asymmetry that degrades unseen-answer ranking. Furthermore, sparse early interactions exhibit both long-range dispersion and local redundancy under skewed distribution. To address these challenges, we propose INSPIRE (Integrating Shared Patterns and Individual Evidence for Reasoning), a two-stage forecasting framework over a known catalog. In Stage I, INSPIRE learns an availability-aware shared-pattern predictor that fuses event-updated memory across the full candidate catalog while applying coordinated query- and catalog-side masking. Subsequently, Stage II freezes this predictor and optimizes a lightweight individual-evidence adapter (EA) combining textual semantic priors with correlation-weighted long-range event statistics under support- and role-balanced co-answer supervision with prior-odds debiasing and soft residual alignment. In addition, we decompose evaluation by endpoint roles and track longitudinal emerging-answer cohorts via query-micro and answer-entity macro metrics. Across four benchmarks based on the ICEWS and GDELT event datasets, INSPIRE improves Emerging MRR by 16.73%-88.83% over the strongest baselines. Relative to paired Stage I predictors, EA further increases Emerging MRR by 8.28%-32.63%, Answer-new MRR by 7.81%-41.24%, and cohort macro MRR by 9.64%-39.94%, gains attributed to semantic priors and candidate-level score competition suppressing mismatched established competitors without zero-support prior shortcuts. The official code is publicly available at https://github.com/KcAcoZhang/INSPIRE.
items.title_ko: 공유된 패턴에서 개별 증거로: 시간적 지식 그래프의 새로운 엔티티를 위한 2단계 추론
items.summary_ko: 이 논문은 시간적 지식 그래프(TKG)에서 새롭게 등장하는 엔티티(emerging entities)의 추론 문제를 다룹니다. 기존 패러다임의 한계를 지적하며, 공유된 패턴에서 개별 증거를 활용하는 2단계 추론 방법을 제시하여, 새로운 엔티티의 상호작용 기록을 효과적으로 모델링합니다.
items.why_ko: 지속적으로 변화하고 새로운 정보가 유입되는 실제 지식 기반 시스템에서, '신생 엔티티'에 대한 효율적인 추론 방법을 제공하여 TKG 기반 애플리케이션의 성능을 향상시킵니다.

items.title: When the Proxy Is Wrong: Mismatch-Corrected Bandits for Adaptive Data Sampling
items.body: Data allocation methods often use a small proxy model to select training data for a larger target model. However, this proxy can rank data differently from the target, leading to suboptimal training performance. To address this problem, we model the mismatch between the proxy and target models and incorporate it into the allocation decision. To do so, the problem is cast as a multi-fidelity bandit, where each arm is a data intervention. The proxy reward is observed every round, whereas the target reward is revealed only on rare audits of the same update. These paired observations identify arm-wise mismatches without assuming a shared offset or preservation of rankings. Mismatch-corrected bandits correct the proxy with paired residuals, audit only uncertain decisions, and pace the audit budget over training. From a theoretical viewpoint, we prove a regret decomposition and lower bounds under stationarity. These bounds show that proxy-only allocation can incur linear regret and that a minimum number of paired audits is necessary. Under abrupt changes, using the audit budget early can also incur linear regret. A sliding-window policy that spreads audits over training achieves regret of order $\sqrt{Γ_T T\log T}$ where $Γ_T$ denotes the number of change points. Experimentally, we test the approach in a closed-loop proof of concept on CivilComments-WILDS, where BERT-Small guides the training of BERT-Large. Mismatch correction improves worst-group accuracy over a target-only policy with the same target-model budget. Spreading audits over training improves worst-group accuracy by 6.3 to 10.5 percentage points at the same audit count.
items.title_ko: 프록시가 틀렸을 때: 적응형 데이터 샘플링을 위한 불일치 보정 밴딧
items.summary_ko: 이 논문은 데이터 할당 방법에서 소규모 프록시 모델이 대규모 타겟 모델과 다르게 데이터를 랭킹할 수 있는 문제, 즉 '프록시-타겟 불일치' 문제를 다룹니다. 이 불일치를 모델링하고 할당 결정에 통합하기 위해 문제를 다중 충실도 밴딧으로 재구성하는 방법을 제시합니다.
items.why_ko: 대규모 모델 훈련 시 데이터 샘플링 전략을 최적화하여 훈련 성능을 향상시키는 데 기여하며, 특히 효율적인 데이터 선택이 중요한 상황에서 유용합니다.

items.title: Maco-RL: Scaling Agent Capabilities with Mixed-Task Reinforcement Learning
items.body: Mixed-task reinforcement learning (MixRL) directly trains a unified policy across domains to continually expand agent capabilities without training separate specialists or requiring an extra distillation stage. Despite its appeal, scaling MixRL poses significant challenges in achieving stable and efficient mixed-task learning, effectively allocating rollout compute, and supporting continual domain expansion. To address these challenges, we propose Maco-RL, an approach that effectively scales MixRL. Specifically, Maco-RL employs a quota-based scheduler for asynchronous rollouts across multiple task domains, thereby stabilizing training by balancing gradient contributions and mitigating off-policy effects. Along an orthogonal axis, Maco-RL further introduces Tri-Buffer Sampling (TBS) to allocate compute among samples with varying levels of mastery, promoting sustained frontier exploration while preserving acquired capabilities. Experiments on five benchmarks show Maco-RL raises Qwen3.5-27B's overall score from 43.6 to 54.2 and then to 60.1 with continual expansion, reaching the frontier held by Qwen3.8-27B, which is further pushed outward by +5.7. Maco-RL also outperforms single-task RL with less compute for policy updates. These results support MixRL as a practical and compute-efficient post-training approach with substantial potential to strengthen general agent capabilities.
items.title_ko: Maco-RL: 혼합 작업 강화 학습으로 에이전트 능력 확장
items.summary_ko: 이 논문은 여러 도메인에 걸쳐 단일 정책을 훈련하여 에이전트의 능력을 지속적으로 확장하는 혼합 작업 강화 학습(MixRL)의 확장에 대한 도전 과제를 다룹니다. 안정적이고 효율적인 혼합 작업 학습, 롤아웃 컴퓨팅 할당, 지속적인 도메인 확장을 지원하기 위해 'Maco-RL' 접근 방식을 제안합니다.
items.why_ko: 하나의 AI 에이전트가 다양한 작업을 학습하고 새로운 도메인으로 능력을 확장할 수 있도록 돕는 방법을 제시하여, 범용 AI 에이전트 개발에 중요한 진전을 가져옵니다.

items.title: Effect of class proportion shifts on classifier curvature
items.body: Changing the class mix can alter mean loss without changing the classifier. To distinguish this reweighting from changes in the model itself, we studied ten-class CIFAR-10 classification in separate branches for two target classes, measuring the trace of the loss Hessian with respect to the output-layer parameters on fixed images of each target class. Across ten new initialisations, after 60 updates to the output layer with frozen features, the trace changed by -0.152% on average in branches where the target class share rose from 10% to 19%, and by +0.071% in branches where it fell to 1%, relative to each branch's initial trace. These changes do not isolate the effect of class share from that of the assigned training images. We developed a forecast based on initial class gradients after examining the first experiment's results and then tested it prospectively without modification. For direct increases from 10% to 19%, rather than increases after a deficit, its mean absolute error was 0.022 percentage points on the initial-trace scale, compared with 0.152 for a zero-change forecast and 0.104 for equally weighted gradients. Using the assigned class proportions improved the forecast of how much the trace would change.
items.title_ko: 클래스 비율 변화가 분류기 곡률에 미치는 영향
items.summary_ko: 이 연구는 클래스 비율 변화가 분류기 자체의 변화 없이 평균 손실을 변경할 수 있음을 조사합니다. CIFAR-10 데이터셋의 10개 클래스 분류에서, 두 개의 대상 클래스에 대한 별도의 브랜치에서 손실 Hessian의 trace를 측정하여 모델 자체의 변화와 재가중치의 효과를 구분합니다.
items.why_ko: AI 모델의 성능 평가 및 편향 분석에서 데이터셋의 클래스 불균형이 모델의 학습에 미치는 영향을 이해하는 데 중요한 통찰을 제공합니다.

items.title: A Failure-Driven Data Flywheel for Post-Training Vision-Language-Action Models
items.body: Pretrained vision-language-action (VLA) models rarely satisfy all behavioral requirements of a new platform, and teams without a large deployed fleet lack the data to address the resulting failures. We propose a failure-driven data flywheel for post-training such models. It constructs target scenarios absent from the available data by inserting task-relevant entities into reconstructed real-world scenes, and evaluates the model against each behavioral requirement of the target task. Failure rates form a failure map across task conditions and difficulty levels, which is re-evaluated after each round and assigns larger data generation quotas to conditions where the model still fails. We instantiate the framework in autonomous driving for occluded-pedestrian emergence and yielding at stop-sign-controlled intersections, and evaluate it on two VLA models and one non-VLA planner in simulation and on a real vehicle. For occluded-pedestrian emergence, five rounds of post-training improve the critical-phase collision-free rate on the sealed test set from 0.261 to 0.579 for AutoVLA and from 0.390 to 0.765 for ReCogDrive, while the unnecessary braking rate in paired control scenarios never exceeds 0.013. On a full-scale vehicle without real-world training, post-trained ReCogDrive achieves 4 of 5 safe passages, versus 1 of 5 for the base model. Fine-grained evaluation reveals a pattern obscured by the collision-free rate alone: both VLA models learn anticipatory deceleration before reaching the occluding vehicle, while braking after pedestrian emergence remains limited. For stop-sign yielding, the stop-before-line rate rises from 0.100 to 0.897 for AutoVLA and from 0.000 to 0.667 for ReCogDrive. With sequential training from the pedestrian-capability models, it reaches 0.599 and 0.358, respectively, while the pedestrian collision-free rate decreases by at most 0.032.
items.title_ko: 실패 주도형 데이터 플라이휠: 훈련 후 시각-언어-행동 모델을 위한 데이터 플라이휠
items.summary_ko: 이 논문은 사전 훈련된 시각-언어-행동(VLA) 모델이 새로운 플랫폼의 모든 행동 요구사항을 충족하지 못하는 문제를 해결하기 위해 '실패 주도형 데이터 플라이휠'을 제안합니다. 실제 장면을 재구성하여 작업 관련 엔티티를 삽입하고, 모델의 행동 요구사항에 대한 실패율을 측정하여 데이터 부족 문제를 해결합니다.
items.why_ko: 로봇이나 에이전트가 실제 환경에서 겪는 실패 사례를 통해 스스로 학습 데이터를 생성하고 모델을 개선하는 순환적인 방법을 제시하여, 자율 에이전트의 지속적인 성능 향상에 기여합니다.

items.title: PoVi: Agentic Poetry-to-Video Generation with Knowledge Grounding and Figurative Understanding
items.body: Poetry-to-video generation requires more than translating text into visual scenes. Poetic language is highly compressed, often depends on historical and cultural knowledge, and frequently conveys meaning through metaphor, imagery, and other non-literal expressions. We introduce PoVi, a benchmark and agentic framework for grounded poetry-to-video generation, evaluating semantic grounding, discourse coherence, and audiovisual realization. PoVi reconstructs poem semantics into an evidence-bounded representation and progressively transforms them into narration, interpretation, character assets, and shot-level visual plans, followed by narration-aligned video generation. Across three planning backbones and four video generators, PoVi consistently improves over single-call generation, with the largest gains on implicit background knowledge and metaphorical relations. PoVi provides a testbed for studying knowledge-grounded, long-horizon multimodal generation beyond direct text-to-video synthesis.
items.title_ko: PoVi: 지식 기반 및 비유적 이해를 통한 에이전트 기반 시-비디오 생성
items.summary_ko: 이 논문은 시(詩)를 영상으로 변환하는 'PoVi' 벤치마크 및 에이전트 기반 프레임워크를 소개합니다. PoVi는 시적 언어가 함축적이고 문화적 지식에 의존하며 비유적 표현을 사용하는 특성을 고려하여, 의미 기반, 담론적 일관성, 시청각적 구현을 평가합니다.
items.why_ko: AI가 시와 같은 복잡하고 추상적인 예술적 표현을 이해하고 영상으로 생성하는 능력을 평가하고 발전시키는 새로운 방법을 제시하여, AI 기반 창의 콘텐츠 생성의 지평을 넓힙니다.

items.title: Evacuation Traffic Prediction for Dynamic Transportation Networks over Multiple Hurricanes: A Generalized Graph Learning Approach
items.body: High traffic demand during hurricane evacuations causes severe congestion on major highways, leading to delays and safety risks for evacuees. Predicting evacuation traffic in real-time can significantly enhance evacuation management efforts. However, evacuation traffic is highly dynamic and uncertain due to evolving hurricane characteristics and diverse population response. Each hurricane has unique characteristics and evacuation contexts, resulting in different spatial-temporal traffic patterns. Moreover, the structure of detector-based transportation networks varies across multiple hurricanes. Hence, a model trained on the data from one hurricane may not generalize well for others. This study proposes a generalized dynamic graph learning framework using traffic detectors and evacuation data from 12 historical hurricanes. Leveraging the dynamic nature of transportation network, we develop a Graph Convolutional Long Short-Term Memory (GCN-LSTM) model that predicts evacuation traffic up to 6 hours in advance. For an unseen hurricane (Milton, 2024), the model shows strong generalizability, achieving an RMSE of 280.6 and R2 of 0.96 for 1-hour prediction, and an RMSE of 459.8 and R2 of 0.89 for overall 6-hours prediction. We also introduce a modular training approach, where we evaluate performance improvements by sequentially incorporating data from multiple hurricanes. The proposed model outperforms state-of-the-art baseline models for overall 6-hour prediction horizons. Ablation experiments show an 8.4% improvement in RMSE for the proposed dynamic GCN-LSTM model compared to its static counterpart. Traffic management officials can use the developed model to understand future traffic conditions during hurricane evacuation in advance and take proactive measures to reduce delays during evacuation.
items.title_ko: 다중 허리케인에 대한 동적 교통 네트워크의 피난 교통 예측: 일반화된 그래프 학습 접근법
items.summary_ko: 이 연구는 허리케인 대피 시 발생하는 교통 체증 예측 문제를 해결하기 위해 '일반화된 그래프 학습' 접근법을 제안합니다. 허리케인 특성과 인구 반응의 다양성으로 인한 대피 교통의 역동성과 불확실성을 고려하여, 실시간 대피 교통 예측 능력을 향상시키고자 합니다.
items.why_ko: 재난 상황에서 AI 기반 교통 예측 시스템이 인간의 생명을 구하고 효율적인 대피를 돕는 데 중요한 역할을 할 수 있음을 보여줍니다.

items.title: Technical Report MEG2text: Beyond Alignment in Non-Invasive Brain-to-Text
items.body: Non-invasive brain-to-text seeks to recover language from brain activity without surgery. A central challenge is turning learned brain-language representations into accurate word predictions. We present MEG2text, a decoding system that combines corrected training and evaluation, brain-text alignment, a class-balanced word readout, and target-word language-model fusion. On LibriBrain100's word-ranking task, MEG2text reaches 64.12% mean Top-10 balanced accuracy, improving on published MEG-XL by 16.92 percentage points across four corpora, with gains on each corpus. Controlled comparisons show that both implementation corrections and a learned readout contribute to this improvement. Candidate-level analysis reveals that some words receive informative scores yet consistently lose to competing candidates, while an identical-feature comparison shows that learning the classification rule improves decoding without changing the representation. These findings identify the decoding rule as a consequential part of non-invasive brain-to-text and show how system improvements can make better use of aligned neural features.
items.title_ko: 기술 보고서 MEG2text: 비침습적 뇌-텍스트 변환에서 정렬을 넘어
items.summary_ko: 이 기술 보고서는 비침습적으로 뇌 활동에서 언어를 복구하는 'MEG2text' 디코딩 시스템을 제시합니다. 뇌-텍스트 정렬, 클래스 균형 단어 판독, 대상 단어 언어 모델 융합 등을 결합하여 LibriBrain100의 단어 랭킹 작업에서 MEG-XL보다 16% 향상된 64.12%의 평균 Top-10 균형 정확도를 달성합니다.
items.why_ko: 뇌 활동에서 직접 텍스트를 복구하는 '뇌-텍스트 인터페이스' 기술의 중요한 발전을 보여주며, 이는 의사소통 장애를 겪는 사람들에게 혁명적인 도움을 줄 잠재력을 가집니다.

items.title: Find the Clue, Not the Scene: Rethinking Reasoning for Entity Recognition in Vision-Language Models
items.body: Answering a knowledge-based visual question requires first recognizing the entity in the image and then recalling knowledge about it. Thinking vision-language models (VLMs) reason for thousands of tokens before answering, yet it remains underexplored how well such thinking VLMs perform each of these two steps. We therefore analyze thinking VLMs on this task and make two key observations. (1) Recognition is the bottleneck, since 76.3% of errors across four models on ViQuAE stem from misrecognizing the entity, and 84.9% of these failures are resolved once the entity name is provided in the question. (2) Recognition is driven by entity-recall clues rather than by general descriptions of the image. An entity-recall clue is a distinctive visual detail that helps the model recall the entity, such as keys, a traditional attribute of Saint Peter. Based on these findings, we propose ClueRL, a reinforcement learning approach that extends Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) with an advantage localized to the entity-recall clue in the thinking trace. Rather than injecting new entity knowledge, ClueRL changes how VLMs think: it leads them to attend more closely to visual details and spot these clues, helping them use the knowledge they already have. Consequently, it outperforms both GRPO and a perception-reward baseline on three entity recognition benchmarks. Moreover, this clue-seeking behavior generalizes beyond entity recognition, the only task used for training. Since recognition is the bottleneck, the gains carry over to knowledge-based visual question answering. They even extend to general multimodal reasoning, raising Qwen3.5-4B by 4.4 and 4.0 points on the ScienceQA and MMMU subsets of MMStar, respectively.
items.title_ko: 단서를 찾아라, 장면이 아니라: 시각-언어 모델의 엔티티 인식 추론 재고
items.summary_ko: 이 연구는 지식 기반 시각적 질문 답변에서 시각-언어 모델(VLM)의 엔티티 인식 추론 능력을 분석합니다. VLM이 수천 개의 토큰으로 추론하지만, 오류의 76.3%가 이미지 내 엔티티를 잘못 인식하는 '인식 병목 현상'에서 비롯됨을 밝혀내며, 이를 해결하기 위한 새로운 접근 방식을 제시합니다.
items.why_ko: VLM이 실제 세계를 정확하게 이해하고 추론하는 데 가장 큰 장애물이 '객체 인식'에 있음을 보여주며, 멀티모달 AI의 시각적 이해 능력 향상을 위한 중요한 연구 방향을 제시합니다.

items.title: Neural Rendering Compiler: Generative Video Models as Programmable Renderers
items.body: Generative video models are becoming powerful renderers, yet lack the predictable control interfaces of conventional systems such as HTML/CSS engines or Blender. Their capabilities emerge implicitly from training, making it difficult to determine what they can reliably execute. We present Neural Rendering Compiler (NeurCo), which automatically probes frozen video models to construct model-specific capability manuals describing which semantic requirements they can reliably satisfy. NeurCo represents user intent in a model-agnostic intermediate representation of objects, constraints, events, and cameras, then compiles it into model-specific execution strategies. Reliable requirements remain unchanged, while unreliable ones are selectively rewritten or compiled into alternative execution strategies.
